title: 1. Get suggestions
caption: This is the experiment view. The plot shows the latent space, and the sidebar holds the language model's suggestions. Click Get Suggestions. Each suggestion is previewed on the plot with dashed arrows and circles.
short: Get Suggestions: each one is previewed with arrows and circles.

title: 2. Move arrows and circles
caption: Adjust a suggestion by dragging an arrow tip, to change its direction and distance. Or drag a circle edge, to change how tight a class is.
short: Arrow tip: direction and distance. Circle edge: tightness.

title: 3. Edit the text
caption: Or edit the suggested text. Type your own words, then click Update plot from instruction. The arrows and circles update to match.
short: Edit the text, then Update plot from instruction.

title: 4. Review every suggestion
caption: Review all five suggestions. Accept applies one to the plot, and Reject discards it. You can tweak a suggestion before accepting it.
short: Accept applies a suggestion. Reject discards it.

title: 5. Add your own
caption: Then add your own. Click Add my own, choose two classes, describe the change, update the plot, and accept.
short: Add my own: pick two classes, write the change, accept.

title: 6. Continue training
caption: When you are done reviewing, click Continue Training. The model then trains with your changes.
short: Continue Training starts training with your changes.
